notes: METADATA_ONLY: this adapter no longer harvests; it derives from admitted metadata only.

This adapter STOPPED emitting G_patch_verification and J_verified_patch. Markdown/GHSA severity labels high/low are legitimate only in severity_reconciliation and must never be admitted into the patch-verification domain.

Two-revision provenance: 575 severity rows carry BOTH vulnerable_commit (audited revision from the report permalink) and fixed_commit (distinct recorded fix SHA). Rows lacking a real audited SHA or a distinct fix SHA carry neither field. This adapter does NOT add rows to prove_candidates.jsonl - mitigation.py owns that NOT_SCORABLE pool.
invariants.jsonl is owned by another writer and is never written by this adapter.
Both severity labels are asserted present in validation and test; the deterministic firm/repo stratification keeps the split reproducible across reruns.
Idempotent derivation: the family file is rewritten from admitted data; no candidate/admitted/invariants/PRESENT/network writes occur here.
